title: WU JEN SIXTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 24 sixth level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R675 OA wu jen sixth level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round sixty-two (capture pp. 196-203): the wu jen sixth level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: WU JEN SIXTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 196-203 - the OA wu jen sixth level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 196-203; compressed pp. 90-93); all 24 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads - the R669-settled Glassee name riding clean in both stat-block passes here (the Glasses misread lived on the spell-list pages, not these). The level carries THREE dual-school prints, the most of any wu jen level yet, all pinned primary (the exaction precedent): gambler's luck the Invocation; Enchantment/Charm dual pinned 8, spiritwrack the Evocation/Abjuration dual and sword of darkness the Evocation/Necromantic dual both pinned 3. Alteration the most common school at nine spells, illusion three, and invocation, conjuration, enchantment/charm, divination and evocation two each; speak with dead the lone necromantic, repulsion the lone abjuration. The component census: 17 VSM, three verbal and somatic (aura, true sight, veil), three V,M (mass suggestion, repulsion, spiritwrack), geas the lone verbal-only. THREE spells take the Casting Time: Special line (enchant an item, move earth, spiritwrack) pinned -1, the R662 exorcise convention; six six-segment (the most common cast), five one-turn, four one-round, gambler's luck and pain the single segments. Three negation saves, five special, NO half save this level. Four spells read Reversible (aura, lower water, metal to rust, stone to flesh). The sixth column cross-checks the R669 element grid: the seven tagged cells matching the landed dieWJT66L6Element pins exactly - five Earth (glassee, metal to rust, move earth, stone to flesh, warp stone) and two Water (lower water, part water). The stat grid pins as a table: 24 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60, -1 the special cast), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and element markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag WJL6Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
